title: a Page owner announces something, with a time on it

criteria.text: Only a Page's managing role can announce or edit; anyone else sees no control and a direct write is refused; an edit happens in place and stays the same announcement
criteria.note: `requireManagingRole` via `managingRoleForKind` in `group.post_create` and `group.post_edit`; an edit is an `update` on the same row id; `page_posts` has no client write policy [V actions/group/post.ts]. Built by #115 (T164) and #183 (T166), neither with `Reviewed by:`; Deploy health green on #183, no run for #115's merge commit (it predates the workflow). Checked: no `[guards F072.1a]` marker exists anywhere [V grep]; `post.test.ts` and `PagePosts.test.tsx` are unmarked (#599).

Retired: Don's 2026-10-02 ruling on #318 ('Owners can delete their own posts'), built in #319 [V gh]. It is not yet a dated line in this scenario's `## Rulings`; `sync-roadmap` should record it. Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: An announcement appears on its Page and in browse, reading as coming from the Page and not as a listing: no price, no buy control, no listing chrome
criteria.note: A post shows on its Page and in browse as coming from the Page, with no price, buy control or listing chrome: no price field in the composer, none in `PagePosts.tsx` or `BrowseResultCard.tsx` [V grep]. Since 10-23 the cards were reworked (#1126 post kinds and lead line, #1143, #1168, #1170, #1140 Page view); the first four carry `Reviewed by:`, #1140 does not, and the original #115/#183/#258 carry none. Checked: unmarked tests; nothing scans for listing chrome (#599, #601). Smoked: no green smoke-live run covers this route after the last merge (root and explore green at 16:20 and 16:52 on 11-06, red on the same commits later; page last opened 11-03, red) [V gh run]

criteria.text: One whose start time has passed stops appearing in browse, with no manual cleanup
criteria.note: Retired by the newer ruling: F121 `## Rulings` 2026-10-30, 'Timely posts leave the shelves and lists at a shelf life set by kind ... shelf life is when a post ends', with F121.3 ('a dated item qualifies only before it ends'). It overtakes 'start time has passed', which was the spec-conflict with #815/#914 keeping a dated post until its end. Built as `post_current_until` / `SHELF_DAYS` in `src/lib/posts/kinds.ts` and `20261031120000_post_kinds.sql` (#1126). Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: One with no event date leaves browse after 14 days and moves to an Earlier section on its Page, unless its owner set a show-until date; it shows Posted <date>
criteria.note: Retired by the same F121 ruling (2026-10-30): an undated post now leaves at its kind's shelf life (news 7 days, offer 7, limited 14, proposal 14, hiring 30) and sits under Past on its Page, replacing the 14-day rule and 'Earlier' section of 2026-10-02 [V kinds.ts]. #914/#965's 'show until' and 'Earlier' were built to the older rule. Shown, not counted; `sync-roadmap` amends the scenario.

criteria.text: The composer takes an optional date and time and an optional address of its own; a start is returned by a time-windowed read to the hour; an undated post is never returned by one; times are the metro's
criteria.note: `group.post_create` writes `starts_at`, `ends_at` and `location_id`; `browse_feed` compares timestamptz bounds and needs `starts_at` for a window; `METRO_TIME_ZONE` in `metro-time.ts` is the one zone, a constant until the metro carries its own (#173) [V]. Built by #183, #212, #258 (no `Reviewed by:`). Checked: unmarked `metro-time.test.ts`, `post.test.ts`, `tests/announcement-card-db.test.ts` (#599). Smoked: no green smoke-live run covers this route after the last merge (root and explore green at 16:20 and 16:52 on 11-06, red on the same commits later; page last opened 11-03, red) [V gh run]

criteria.text: One switch for who it reaches, defaulting to anyone; the words name the people, neither "announcement" nor "bulletin" is in any label; beside the restricted setting a live count that reads as words at zero
criteria.note: `AudienceSwitch.tsx`: 'Anyone' by default, the restricted setting shown but not postable (delivery is cut), the count reads in words at zero; the words 'announcement' and 'bulletin' appear only in code comments and in the unrouted sell flow, not in a composer label [V]. Built by #183 (no `Reviewed by:`). One test reads one label (`PagePosts.test.tsx`); nothing scans every label and state (#601); all unmarked (#599). The composer is not opened by smoke-live.

criteria.text: An announcement that fails to save leaves nothing behind: no half-made row on the Page, in browse or in its history
criteria.note: `group.post_create` is one insert in a transaction; a failed save leaves no row [V actions/group/post.ts]. Built by #183. Checked: unmarked tests (#599).

criteria.text: An announcement or gathering may carry an optional end time; one with a time offers add-to-calendar; its image carries default alt text built from title, date and place; the label stays Event
criteria.note: Half built: `ends_at` with a check constraint (#263), `.ics` with DTEND and `AddToCalendarLink` (#261), and `cardImageAlt` (title, date, place) on browse cards [V]. Missing: a Page's own post photo takes the first line of the post as alt (`PagePosts.tsx` line 701), with no fallback to title, date and place (#596). F099.10 now reads 'owner's words, else the default', which this still lacks. The label 'Event' is not asserted [A]. Held by the build freeze.
